title: Faryaad ya Ali
body:
Kubra ke toote khalb ki awaaz thi yehi faryaad ya Ali
Kaisi ajeeb dekhiye shaadi meri huwi faryaad ya Ali
Do pal mein bewa hogayi maien shah-e-mashraqain kisse karongi bain
Sughra bahen bhi dur madine mein reh gayi faryaad ya Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek showr tha ke ghode se ibne Hassan gira dil mera phat gaya , sunti hoon laash ghodon se pamaal hogayi faryaad ya Ali
Dulhan ko toh libaase uroosi pinhate hain mehendi lagate hain, ghongat maien kaise daalti chadar bhi chhin gayi faryaad ya Ali
Dekho mere badan mein hain bewa ka pairahan jaise ke ho kafan, kangne ki ja kalayi mein rassi hai bandh gayi faryaad ya Ali
Ashan har ek simt tha ek hashr ka samaan rooti thi bibiyan , kubra tadap ke kehti thi maien kyon na margayi faryaad ya Ali..
